answers.core: This proposal affects core rendering functionality.
answers.workaround:
No, it can't. Lights involve deep rendering processes, and the ways in which they affect the world cannot be controlled using scripts.

The only method that presently comes close to achieving this affect is to use material shaders with a custom light function. This would require a lot of work, while ultimately still failing to limit volumetric fog or global illumination.
